exposure: Exposure during first trimester (1-7th days of pregnancy)
Exposure during second trimester (8-14th days of pregnancy)
Exposure during third trimester (15-21st days of pregnancy)
outcome: Antioxidant levels (SOD, CAT, GPX, TAS, GSH) in maternal and fetal lung tissues
Oxidative stress parameters (TBARS, TOS) in maternal and fetal lung tissues
cohort: Pregnant rats exposed to different doses of paracetamol during various trimesters of pregnancy.
finding: Exposure to paracetamol during pregnancy caused toxic damage to both maternal and fetal lung organs, particularly with long-term usage and during the third trimester, characterized by decreased antioxidant levels and increased oxidative stress.
gest_age: Term (21 days gestational age for rats, when fetuses were removed)
